displayName: Niche 6: Mẹ đơn thân / Phụ nữ nghèo lật kèo
description: Romance and urban comeback drama centered on a single mom or poor woman protecting a child or younger sibling, surviving secret-child pressure, custody threats, daycare and school-gate shame, gig and shift labor, hidden skill behind the day job, and a late-arc protective love story or restored career. The engine is care labor + comeback through hidden skill, not corporate paperwork (-> Niche 8) and not blood-family inheritance (-> Niche 4).
emotionalAxis: single mom dignity, urban romance pressure, poor woman comeback, custody threat, secret child truth, work survival, hidden skill behind survival labor, protective love arrives only after dignity is rebuilt

chapterArcDefaults.hookStyle: vulnerable woman is mocked while quietly protecting someone (child, sibling, elderly parent), with hidden skill and dignity already in place

humiliationPacing: she is mocked as poor or single in front of the child or in front of the child's school
workplace, daycare, school gate, clinic, or pawn-shop shame escalates with audience
a custody threat or absent father returns the moment her comeback begins
the child or sibling becomes the emotional truth carrier she must protect
the mockers assume her hidden skill belongs to a man (boss, ex, tutor, fake mentor)
she is offered hush money to stay silent about a powerful person's child
the school or daycare uses 'community standards' to push her out
she is denied a promotion because someone says she will leave for the child
the rent / eviction / clinic-bill crisis hits during the same week as the public mockery
revengeActivation: her competence proves itself in front of the same mockers
the child reveals a hidden truth (parentage, talent, witness statement) at the right moment
custody, daycare, school, or clinic records clear her formally
she gains institutional power (license, contract, equity, patent, board seat)
the same mockers come back asking for her professional help
she refuses hush money and files her own custody / paternity / wage-theft packet
a protective partner arrives only after dignity is already rebuilt, not as rescuer
she funds another single mom's exit so the comeback is structural, not personal
the absent father is held accountable on paper before any reconciliation conversation
dignityRecoveryTiming: warm but firm late comeback — she rebuilds career, custody, and chosen community first, and only then accepts romance or family healing on her own terms

belongsHere: single mom or poor woman protecting a child / sibling / elderly parent
custody, daycare, school, clinic, and gig-labor survival drama
hidden skill behind the day job, comeback through competence
absent father return and child-support / paternity paperwork
protective love story that arrives after dignity is rebuilt, not as rescue
doesNotBelongHere: blood-family inheritance / will / deed fraud (-> Niche 4)
office contract wife / paper marriage / hostile takeover (-> Niche 8)
wedding day cheating / mistress drama (-> Niche 5)
rich-poor courtship without single-mom or poor-woman engine (-> Niche 1)
